title: g-tee-oh node dump
description: A generic dump of solved nodes that tools/library-pack turns into the library format (R0.7, R2.8, O-26): the game configuration the nodes were solved for, the position pair, and per node the actions, then per hand the action frequencies and one expected value (EV) per action. Amounts in centi-big-blinds (cbb) are integers and EVs are in big blinds (bb). The rules a schema cannot express (frequencies summing to 1, one frequency and one EV per action, hand labels matching the hand space, no duplicate hands or tokens) live in src/node-dump.ts.

schema_version.description: The version of this dump schema; a reader rejects any other value.

source.description: Where the nodes come from (A4 solution_source): imported as a reference, or solved by this project's engine.

config.description: The game configuration the nodes were solved for.

config_id.description: The identifier of the matching game_config row when the configuration is seeded, for example cfg_6_online_100 (O-112).

position_pair.description: The two positions the nodes belong to, out of position first.

hand_space.description: How hands are labelled (A3 section 1): the 169 preflop classes such as AKs, or the 1326 card combinations such as AhKh.

exploitability_pct_pot.description: The exploitability the solve reached, in percent of the pot, one value per position in pair order when known.

nodes.description: The solved nodes, each with its actions and per-hand strategy.

game_config.description: The game configuration the nodes were solved for (A4 game_config), with the stake as a label.

format.description: Whether the game is an online or a live game, which decides the sizing conventions.

table_size.description: How many seats the table has, from heads-up to nine-handed.

stake_label.description: The blinds as players name them, for example 0.5/1.

depth_cbb.description: The effective stack depth in centi-big-blinds (cbb), so 10000 is one hundred big blinds.

straddle.description: True when a straddle is posted, which adds a forced bet after the big blind.

ante_cbb.description: The ante each player posts in centi-big-blinds (cbb), zero when there is none (O-33).

config_id.description: A seeded game_config identifier: cfg_, the table size, the format and the numeric parts of the stake and depth (O-112).

position_pair.description: Two position labels joined by a hyphen, out of position first, for example BB-BTN.

position.description: One position label, for example BTN or UTG+1.

timestamp.description: A point in time in Coordinated Universal Time with the Z suffix, ISO 8601 (the pattern stands in for the date-time format).

node.description: One decision point of the tree: who acts, what is in the pot, the actions available and the strategy per hand.

node_key.description: The node key (A3): a tree identifier, the position pair and the action line so far, separated by slashes, with an empty line at the root.

street.description: The street the node is on.

board.description: The board cards dealt so far as rank then suit, empty before the flop.

to_act.description: The position that acts at this node.

pot_cbb.description: The pot before the action at this node, in centi-big-blinds (cbb).

stacks_cbb.description: The stack behind of each position in pair order, in centi-big-blinds (cbb).

actions.description: The actions available at this node, in the order the frequencies and EVs follow.

hands.description: The strategy per hand at this node.

accuracy_pct_pot.description: The solve's accuracy at this node in percent of the pot, which feeds the accuracy floor (O-22).

action.description: One available action: its token and its size.

token.description: The action token: f fold, x check, c call, l limp, a all-in, s<n> straddle, b<n> bet and r<n> raise, with the size in centi-big-blinds (cbb) as n.

size_cbb.description: The total wager the action puts in, in centi-big-blinds (cbb), zero for a fold or a check.

hand_strategy.description: The strategy of one hand at a node: how often it takes each action and what each action is worth.

hand.description: The hand label in the dump's hand space: a preflop class such as AKs or 72o, or two cards such as AhKh.

reach.description: How likely each position holds the hand at this node, in pair order, between 0 and 1.

frequencies.description: How often the hand takes each action, in action order, between 0 and 1 and summing to 1.

ev_bb.description: The expected value (EV) of each action for the hand in big blinds (bb), in action order, one per action.
